evidence_slice: South Downs National Park Authority's adopted South Downs Local Plan (2 July 2019) allocates Policy SD76, Land at Old Malling Farm, Lewes, for 220-240 residential dwellings. The authority's South Downs Transport Study dated 12 November 2024 lists SD76 as Housing, 226 dwellings, status 'Permission, but yet to start'. The authority-hosted Local_Plan_Service FeatureServer includes layer 13 named 'Housing Site Allocation' in British National Grid EPSG:27700.
